blocking_issues: This primary reproduction and the unchanged secondary Figure 6b improvement target are different result scopes. Do not force shared descriptions or finalize a same-target four-cell bundle; canonical binding owner must keep the bundle unavailable until scope-consistent contracts exist.

The scalar/categorical findings are partial. Full regional slope/direction distributions, animal-level values/variation, every source sample-size statistic, complete inhibition/control outputs and numerical STDP/BTSP comparisons remain mandatory outside the finding list. No vector family is represented as a scalar or replaced by a qualitative label.

Authenticate the original primary source-to-result panel, input and control manifest, including both optogenetic session branches, timing joins, source mouse identities, all model configurations/repeats and indispensable supplementary controls. The README family map alone is insufficient; do not expand silently to every paper figure.

Resolve literal pooled versus helper/animal significance boundaries and denominators, undefined/zero-slope rows, familiar/new orientation, per-animal pairing and optogenetic contrast directions. Regional and optogenetic source COM conversions differ; no convenient unified preprocessing is admitted.

Animal-level targets and exact final-paper numerical linkage are unbound. Pooled fields are not animals; nine optogenetic mice and regional source-assigned animal labels do not establish independent field samples or a new uncertainty rule.

Source-native STDP/BTSP numerical distributions, realistic firing-rate/field-width constraints, dynamic-input/alternative-rule controls and parameter/rule-asymmetry sweeps are unqualified. Do not select a favorable branch or use better empirical regression fit as mechanistic proof.

The accepted Figure 6b observation/scoring utility is secondary and scores supplied values. It is not a primary submitted-analysis runner or independently bound empirical/model verifier. Require actual frozen-program execution and per-field/animal/interval/configuration derivation before accepting printed paper summaries.

All numerical tolerances and inferential criteria remain unresolved. Reported p values, source bootstrap confidence intervals, rounding and qualitative agreement do not justify invented equivalence bands, effect thresholds, independent-unit minima or model-selection rules.

Retain the separate secondary Figure 6b complete vector and two-versus-three-parameter, compressed missing-lap timing and raw-versus-clipped R-squared conflicts. Its exact predecessor sidecars and accepted implementation remain preserved externally and locally without promotion to primary evidence.

No immutable primary analysis interface, authentic common packet/code-only addition, independent granular verifier or cumulative resource/access protocol is bound. No eligible admission policy, AI execution result or successful scientific outcome is asserted.
